fields.name: Vipin Sendha Namak
fields.description:
Unrefined: Shudh Sendha Namak is free from additives, anti-caking agents, or chemical processing.
Natural Harvest: Usually sourced from natural salt mines or salt pans, harvested in a way that preserves its natural minerals.
Widely used during religious fasts (vrats) like Navratri because it is considered pure and permissible when many other salts and spices are avoided.
Helps maintain electrolyte balance during fasting.
